technique.summary: Detect and exploit SSTI by injecting template syntax into user-controlled input. Different template engines have different syntax, so polyglot payloads help identify the engine. SSTI frequently leads to RCE. When output is not reflected, use error-based detection (different engines produce distinct errors) or time-based detection via heavy computation payloads (monitor responseTimeMs).
steps: If 49 appears in the response, SSTI is confirmed — identify the engine
Escalate from information disclosure to RCE via engine-specific gadget chains
If no reflection: inject error-provoking payloads and compare error responses per engine
Jinja2 error probe: {{[].pop()}} triggers IndexError; Twig: {{1/0}} vs Jinja2 {{1/0}} produce different error signatures
Time-based blind detection: inject heavy computation payload and monitor responseTimeMs for delay
Jinja2 time-based: {{range(99999999)|join('')}} causes measurable delay if SSTI is present

payloads.notes: Returns 7777777 in Jinja2, 49 in Twig — helps fingerprint engine
Jinja2 — dumps Flask config including SECRET_KEY
Jinja2 blind detection — triggers IndexError (pop from empty list)
Error-based engine fingerprinting — Jinja2 returns ZeroDivisionError, Twig returns INF
Jinja2 time-based blind detection — heavy computation causes measurable delay in responseTimeMs

bypassTechniques: Use attr() filter in Jinja2 to bypass dot-notation restrictions
Error-based detection for blind SSTI: compare error responses across engines to fingerprint without reflection
Time-based detection via heavy computation: use responseTimeMs to detect processing delays from payloads like {{range(N)|join('')}}
